title: Personal Agent Pattern: Agent Gateway (IG) path
lede: The same pattern with Agent Gateway (IG) as the MCP gateway. On this path the token exchange (OBO) is shown as available, through Agent IAM Core. UNVERIFIED: what IG enforces at each step has not been confirmed, so only the OBO difference is drawn.

steps.title: asks
steps.what: The user asks their personal agent for something. The agent is theirs; it acts for one person.

steps.title: prompt
steps.what: The agent uses a language model to decide which tool to call. The model never holds a credential.

steps.title: User authenticates
steps.what: The user signs in through Agent IAM Core. The agent receives a token whose audience is the MCP gateway and whose subject is the user.

steps.title: MCP / OIDC
steps.what: The agent calls Agent Gateway (IG) over MCP with that token.

steps.title: Token exchange (OBO)
steps.what: Agent Gateway (IG) swaps the token through Agent IAM Core for an on-behalf-of token for the MCP server, same subject. It depends on MCP support.

steps.title: MCP
steps.what: Agent Gateway (IG) calls the MCP server with the exchanged token.

steps.title: API call
steps.what: The MCP server calls the backend through the API gateway.

steps.title: Fine grained
steps.what: Agent Authorize applies finer-grained, business-level rules to this request and data.

steps.title: allowed call
steps.what: Only a request that passed both layers reaches the resource.
